data.title: War Elephants eyeing last-8 spot with a victory over Hong Kong
data.description: Thailand target another three points as they take on Hong Kong in their second Group A match in the 20th Asian Games men's football tournament at Toyota Stadium in Japan on Sunday.

data.title: Five cheers for Kingdom's heroes as they celebrate golden wins
data.description: Thailand's national golf team brought home five titles at the Southeast Asian Amateur Golf Team Championships 2026 in Hong Kong on Friday.

data.title: The biggest sporting show begins
data.description: Nagoya: The 20th Asian Games were declared open by Japan's emperor on Saturday following a troubled build-up to the multi-sport spectacular that has more athletes than the Olympics.

data.title: Arsenal thrashed by Brighton, sorry Spurs lose again
data.description: LONDON - Arsenal's perfect start to their Premier League title defence came off the rails in a 3-0 trouncing by Brighton, while Tottenham remain winless after a 3-2 defeat to Aston Villa.

data.title: 'Fragile' Tottenham beaten by Aston Villa despite late rally
data.description: LONDON - The end to Tottenham's Premier League goal drought came too late as Aston Villa won 3-2 in north London on Saturday to compound a miserable start for Roberto De Zerbi's men.

data.title: Martin wins Austrian MotoGP sprint after Acosta crash
data.description: SPIELBERG (AUSTRIA) - Jorge Martin won Saturday's Austrian MotoGP sprint race to retake the championship lead from Marc Marquez, after Pedro Acosta crashed out with victory in sight.

data.title: ONE Championship: Kiamran Nabati tells Yod-IQ to ‘polish my belt’ after Nontachai win
data.description: Kiamran Nabati has put himself back in the ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai title conversation after rebounding with a unanimous decision over Nontachai Jitmuangnon at The Inner Circle 31.

data.title: Asian Games to open in Japan after troubled build-up
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - The 20th Asian Games will open in Japan later Saturday with a glittering ceremony following a stuttering build-up to a multi-sport spectacular that has more participants than the Olympics.

data.title: Crunch time for Spurs and Villa, Dockyard Derby back
data.description: There is a huge match at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium today with a clash between two big Premier League teams that had been strongly tipped for European places but currently find themselves struggling near the foot of the table.

data.title: Kingdom's stars chase redemption on two wheels in Nagoya
data.description: Four years ago in Hangzhou, Thailand's best hope for cycling gold lost it in the final metres -- beaten to the line by a Japanese rider on Chinese soil. Now the rematch comes full circle: the 20th Asian Games are being held in Japan itself, and Thailand's cycling team has arrived determined not to let history repeat.

data.title: Thais target bigger haul than Hangzhou
data.description: Thailand's 694-member team -- a blend of Olympic medallists, world champions, former winners and a host of first-timers -- will head into the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 aiming to put on a better show than they did in Hangzhou, China, three years ago.

data.title: Kwanchanok and Miguel are Thailand Amateur Open champs
data.description: Kwanchanok Boonchan and Ilas Miguel won the 92nd Singha Thailand Amateur Open 2026 after yesterday's final round at Panya Indra Golf Club was cancelled because of heavy rain.

data.title: Thai spikers, teqball aces seal progress
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team swept aside Taiwan 3-0 to cruise into the quarter-finals as Pool C winners, capping off a dominant run through the preliminary phase at the Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium in Okazaki City, Aichi Prefecture, on Friday.

data.title: BG Pathum fight back to hold Sailors
data.description: BG Pathum United fought back to secure a 1-1 draw against Singapore's Lion City Sailors in their AFC Champions League Two Group F fixture on Thursday.

data.title: Australian athlete who soiled herself apologises for continuing Hyrox race
data.description: SYDNEY - An Australian athlete who sparked an outcry when she kept competing despite soiling herself midway through an event in Beijing apologised Friday and forfeited her points from winning.

data.title: Juventus, Palace cruise to Europa League wins, Bournemouth beat Sociedad
data.description: LONDON - Juventus began their quest for Europa League glory with a 5-0 thrashing of NEC Nijmegen, while Bournemouth secured an impressive victory at Real Sociedad on their European debut on Thursday.

data.title: Man Utd misery puts Carrick under pressure, Spurs feeling the heat
data.description: LONDON - Michael Carrick needs a win at Fulham to ease the mounting pressure on troubled Manchester United while Tottenham are desperate for their first Premier League goal of the season against fellow strugglers Aston Villa.

data.title: English Championship rivals brace for renewal of bitter feuds
data.description: LONDON - Police are on red alert as the English Championship braces for the renewal of two bitter feuds when Millwall face West Ham and Wolves meet West Brom this weekend.

data.title: Star vows no let-up against HK
data.description: Midfielder Worawut Noisri says Thailand have no plans to hold back in their second men's football group-phase match against Hong Kong.

data.title: Action starts                         gripping fans,                         says Patama
data.description: Khunying Patama Leeswadtrakul, a member of the International Olympic Committee (IOC), has confirmed that over 20,000 athletes and officials from 45 nations will participate at the 20th Asian Games, scheduled for Sept 19 to Oct 4 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

data.title: Banlung chases Aichi glory
data.description: When the taekwondo mats are laid out in Aichi-Nagoya on Oct 1, Thailand will send in a squad shaped less by ambition than by absence.

data.title: Equestrian teams ready to put in their best
data.description: Thailand's national equestrian team are set to compete in dressage and eventing competitions at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabati vs Nontachai on as both pass Inner Circle 31 weigh-ins
data.description: Kiamran Nabati and Nontachai Jitmuangnon’s delayed bantamweight Muay Thai clash is finally on after both cleared Thursday’s weigh-ins and hydration tests for The Inner Circle 31.

data.title: Asian Games chief defends ‘functional’ rooms after backlash
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - Accommodation for Asian Games athletes in Japan is “functional” and efforts are being made to deal with numerous complaints from disgruntled teams, a chief organiser told AFP.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ferrari Fairtex finds belief in small gloves after surviving Julio Lobo scare
data.description: Ferrari Fairtex is beginning to find something in ONE Championship’s small gloves that his talent alone could not guarantee: a way through the bad moments.

data.title: Croc-habitat river approved for 2032 Olympic rowing
data.description: SYDNEY - A river home to crocodiles was approved Thursday as the 2032 Brisbane Olympics rowing and canoeing venue by the sport’s governing bodies after a “thorough and robust assessment”.

data.title: Carrick takes blame as Man U suffer League Cup misery
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - Michael Carrick took the blame for Manchester United's stunning League Cup collapse against Brighton after furious fans jeered his side at Old Trafford on Wednesday.

data.title: Carrick takes the blame as troubled Man Utd suffer League Cup misery
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Michael Carrick took the blame for Manchester United's stunning League Cup collapse against Brighton after furious fans jeered his side at Old Trafford on Wednesday.

data.title: Mbappe explains Ceuta shirt stance after criticism
data.description: BARCELONA - Real Madrid superstar Kylian Mbappe said on Wednesday that he wanted to make a gesture in support of immigrants who had lost their lives by not wearing a t-shirt in support of the people of Ceuta properly.

data.title: Lanlana quits squad for her LA28 dream
data.description: Thailand's No.1 tennis player Lanlana Tararudee has withdrawn from the Asian Games team as she aims to focus on improving her world ranking to boost her chance of qualifying for the 2028 Olympic Games.

data.title: Thais complete stunning comeback
data.description: Paripan Wongsa struck twice to complete a remarkable turnaround as Thailand came from two goals down to beat Kyrgyzstan 3-2 in their opening Group A match in the 20th Asian Games men's football tournament at Toyota Stadium in Japan on Wednesday.

data.title: Buriram hold on for a point at Johor
data.description: Thai League champions Buriram United came away with a point after a 1-1 draw with Malaysia's Johor Darul Ta'zim at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium in the opening round of the AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 league phase on Tuesday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Suriyanlek ‘extremely lucky’ as he resumes training after van accident
data.description: Thai fighter Suriyanlek Por Yenying says he feels “extremely lucky” to be back in training after being hit by a van while out running, with the accident giving him fresh motivation to chase a full-time ONE Championship contract.

data.title: ONE Championship: Jonathan Haggerty’s 48-hour Bangkok dash before Akimoto fight – ‘back to work’
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty had barely unpacked from Tokyo when he turned around and headed back to Asia for barely 48 hours – paying for a business-class ticket himself to limit the physical toll of another long-haul journey during fight camp, without sacrificing a day of training.

data.title: Messi set for Argentina farewell in Benin friendly
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Lionel Messi was on Tuesday named in Argentina's squad for a friendly against Benin on October 6, a match that will serve as his farewell appearance after announcing his international retirement last month.

data.title: The Bernhard Langer I quite foolishly turned down
data.description: 'No, I can't', l said to a member, who had a 17-year-old Bernhard Langer standing next to him and who was asking if I would like to join them for a game. This reply will haunt me right up until l leave this planet, but at the time I was busy and the thought of playing with this scrawny anaemic-looking German kid was not too appealing.

data.title: Port aim to scalp Japanese giants Vissel in big ACL test
data.description: Port will have to be at their best when they face Vissel Kobe in the AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 today.
